item.title: Careshots — Episode 30: Abbott's Heart Lead, Aravax's Peanut Win, Payers' Q3 Rebound
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Abbott's UltiSynq defibrillation lead winning FDA approval and a CE mark, Aravax's once-monthly peanut allergy shot posting strong Phase 2 results in kids, and the big payers' Q3 rebound — built on shedding members while hospitals absorb the fallout. Plus a lightning round: NervGen's Breakthrough Therapy designation for spinal cord injury.

item.title: Careshots — Episode 29: Oura's $625M Care Bet, Amgen's Sjögren's First, Lilly's PsA Combo
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Oura's $625M acquisition of Counsel Health to turn its ring into a doctor's office, Amgen's first-ever Phase 3 win in Sjögren's disease, and Lilly stacking Taltz and Zepbound in psoriatic arthritis. Plus a lightning round: Inovio's DNA immunotherapy approval and Freenome's big quarter.
